description: This Java source file implements a Spark Streaming application that consumes messages from an Amazon Kinesis stream, performs a word count on the incoming data, and outputs the results. It sets up Kinesis input streams, processes byte arrays into words, and counts their occurrences.

classes.name: JavaKinesisWordCountASL
classes.description: Main class implementing a Spark Streaming application for reading from Kinesis and performing word count.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point of the application; sets up Spark Streaming context, configures Kinesis streams, processes data, and starts streaming.
